name: Yanis Varoufakis
role: Greek economist; finance minister of Greece (Jan–Jul 2015); co-founder of DiEM25 and MeRA25
summary: Varoufakis is a Greek economist and politician who sees Europe's institutions as an oligarchy that has stripped democracy of power, and wants a democratised, decentralised European federation. He backs worker cooperatives, a basic income, a job guarantee, democratised central banks and a Green New Deal, and is against austerity and the fossil-fuel economy. On foreign policy he opposed NATO expansion and European rearmament and favours a negotiated peace in Ukraine.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, counts the exploitation of animals as part of what it opposes and calls for de-growth in factory farming.

basic-income.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, calls for an unconditional basic income paid by democratised central banks.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on faith and celebrates a diverse Europe of many faiths and philosophies, which this contradicts.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, wants democratised central banks that provide basic income and a job guarantee.

citizens-assembly.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, proposes democratic deliberation councils of randomly selected residents and constitutional people's assemblies.

corporate-influence.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, names lobbyists and cartels as pulling the strings of governments and EU institutions.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on skin colour, national origin, gender, faith or sexual orientation, which a law of this kind would contradict.

decide-locally.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges a decentralised Europe that uses central power to maximise democracy in towns, cities and regions.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on skin colour, national origin, gender, faith or sexual orientation, which a law of this kind would contradict. It also pledges freedom to choose partners.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges to leave all fossil fuels in the ground and runs a comprehensive Green New Deal for Europe.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges to end every discrimination based on class, gender, skin colour, national origin, faith, disability or sexual orientation.

ethnic-nation.rationale: In his openDemocracy debate on DiEM25 he says nations were never monocultural and opposes nationalism's attempt to erase underlying identities.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges leaving all fossil fuels deep inside the earth and opposes fossil fuel extraction.

experts-over-public.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, attacks unelected technocrats and 'pseudo-technocratic' decision-making presented as neutral, and demands democratic control.

flat-income-tax.rationale: The MeRA25 manifesto, which he wrote to found the party, calls for greater progressivity in income tax rates.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on faith and celebrates a diverse Europe of many faiths and philosophies, which this contradicts. It also pledges freedom to choose partners in life.

job-guarantee.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, calls for a job guarantee provided by democratised central banks.

limit-growth.rationale: The MeRA25 manifesto, which he wrote to found the party, recognises natural limits to economic growth, and DiEM25's manifesto calls for de-growth in sectors that harm the environment.

nation-first.rationale: The MeRA25 manifesto promises no policies that benefit Greeks at the expense of other peoples and calls itself internationalist; DiEM25's manifesto pledges an internationalist Europe.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, aims at a post-capitalist system free of both capitalist bosses and domineering state bureaucrats.

one-party-rule.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto calls for democracy and a pluralist Europe; it opposes authoritarianism.

open-borders.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, calls borders and fences signs of weakness and wants an open Europe; it does not say all borders should be abolished.

open-government-data.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges comprehensive transparency, with all decision-making under citizens' scrutiny.

participatory-democracy.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, aims at an authentic, decentralised, participatory democracy.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, speaks of the patriarchy's suppression of women's and LGBTQIA+ people's self-determination and aims at a feminist system.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, says Europeans have given up on their politicians 'and they are right', and that parties betray their principles in power.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, seeks a democratic European Republic with a pan-European constitution and a transnational political representation, and rejects sealing national borders as the answer to lost sovereignty.

positive-liberty.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges a Europe that cherishes not only freedom from interference but also the basic income, care and goods that make one free from need.

public-access-to-information.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges a transparent Europe where all decision-making takes place under citizens' scrutiny.

purge-loanwords.rationale: In his openDemocracy debate on DiEM25 he names the attempt to cleanse language of 'foreign' impurities as part of nationalism, which he opposes.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto pledges a welcoming Europe and ends discrimination by skin colour and national origin.

racial-franchise.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on skin colour, national origin, gender, faith or sexual orientation, which a law of this kind would contradict.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on skin colour, national origin, gender, faith or sexual orientation, which a law of this kind would contradict.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges a welcoming Europe that welcomes migrants and refugees.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: As finance minister in 2015 he refused to sign the creditors' austerity programme without debt restructuring, and resigned after the July 2015 deal, as told in his memoir; this is his own account of his record.

religious-nation.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on faith and celebrates a diverse Europe of many faiths and philosophies, which this contradicts.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto pledges ending every discrimination based on skin colour, national origin, gender, faith or sexual orientation, which a law of this kind would contradict.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, wants international money flows managed to fund green and social public investment in the less developed parts of the planet.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: His proposal for Ukraine's neutrality does not state a position for his own country.

suppress-opposition.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto calls for stemming authoritarianism of every kind and for a pluralist Europe.

trade-surplus.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, wants international trade and money flows managed to iron out imbalances such as trade surpluses and deficits.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: In his openDemocracy debate on DiEM25 he says the Left understood the nation as an artefact of relatively recent historical forces, a view he says he still holds.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, commits to disobey every ethically or politically unacceptable directive of the status quo.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, argues that rule by the rich few (oligarchy) is the opposite of democracy and that Europeans live in oligarchies where election results are ignored if they clash with oligarchs' interests.

women-suffrage.rationale: DiEM25's manifesto pledges to end every discrimination based on gender.

worker-ownership.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, envisions an economy of cooperative enterprises run on one-person-one-share-one-vote.

workplace-democracy.rationale: The DiEM25 manifesto, which he co-founded and wrote the long version of, pledges a postcapitalist Europe practising democracy at the workplace.

notes: Themes searched: economy, government, world (Ukraine, NATO, EU), ecology, technology and society, in the DiEM25 manifesto, six of his books and interviews. Society and liberty issues (marriage, abortion, drugs, guns) and most ideology-specific statements had no stated position found. Another Now is a novel and is not used for answers.
